	<menu type="embeddedBranch">
		<description>Bufferpools (2)</description>
		
	<menu type="embeddedBranch">
		<description>IBMDEFAULTBP</description>
		
	<menu type="leaf" branchDirectory="" >
		<pageWindow target="_active">
			<splitPane direction="h">
				<topPane>
					<panel name="main" PrimaryContainer="true">
						<link type="action" target="_self" window="_self" connectionRequired="y">
							<parameterList>
								<parameter name="table">bufferpool</parameter>
								<parameter name="action">display</parameter>
								<parameter name="bpname">IBMDEFAULTBP</parameter>
							    
							</parameterList>
						</link>				
					</panel>
				</topPane>
				<bottomPane>
					<panel name="detail"/>
				</bottomPane>
			</splitPane>
		</pageWindow>
		<description>Detail</description>
	</menu>

	<menu type="branch" 
		branchSQLXML='select XMLELEMENT( NAME @@@tablespaces@@@ , XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME @@@tablespace@@@ ,XMLATTRIBUTES( TBSPACE as TBSPACE)) order by TBSPACE) ) from SYSCAT.TABLESpaces s join syscat.bufferpools b on s.BUFFERPOOLID=b.BUFFERPOOLID'
		branchXSL="XSL/object2Menu"
		
			branchSQLPredicate="BPNAME = ?!value=IBMDEFAULTBP?"
		
		delayLoad="mouse"
		replacement="true">
		dropParent="false">
		<description>Tablespaces</description>
	</menu>

		
	</menu>
